Card Q&A.a: No, you can't.  A "by" condition can't be met if only some of the required actions are performed.  The conditions for this [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect require you to trash the specified number of cards under your Tamer.
Card Q&A.q: Can I trash just 1 face-down card from under a Tamer for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?
Can I trash a total of 2 face-down cards from under multiple Tamers for the conditions of this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. It can't unsuspend until their turn ends. Then, by trashing 2 bottom face-down cards from under any of your Tamers, this Digimon may digivolve into a [DATA SQUAD] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Rosemon] in its name or the [DATA SQUAD] trait would leave the battle area, by trashing the bottom face-down card from under any of your Tamers, it doesn't leave.
